# netapp-storagegrid_grid_account (Data Source)

Reads a tenant account of StorageGRID, by its name or by its ID, with the Grid Management API. StorageGRID never returns the password of the root user of the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# a tenant account, by its name (the name does not have to be unique: use the id then)
data "netapp-storagegrid_grid_account" "by_name" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"
  name            = "analytics"
}

# or by its id
data "netapp-storagegrid_grid_account" "by_id" {
  cx_profile_name = "grid1"
  id              = "12345678901234567890"
}

output "analytics_quota_bytes" {
  value = data.netapp-storagegrid_grid_account.by_name.quota_object_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name. The profile must be a grid profile, without `account_id`.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the tenant account, a number assigned by StorageGRID. Set `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the tenant account. Set `name` or `id`. The name does not have to be unique: the data source fails when several tenant accounts have the name, use the `id` then.

### Read-Only

- `allow_compliance_mode` (Boolean) Whether the tenant can use the compliance mode for S3 Object Lock. It is not set before StorageGRID 11.9.
- `allow_platform_services` (Boolean) Whether the tenant can use the platform services, such as CloudMirror replication, notifications and search integration.
- `allow_select_object_content` (Boolean) Whether the tenant can use the S3 SelectObjectContent API. It is not set before StorageGRID 11.6.
- `capabilities` (Set of String) Capabilities of the tenant account: `s3`, the object storage protocol, and `management`, which users need to sign in to the Tenant Manager and to use the Tenant Management API.
- `description` (String) Additional information that identifies the tenant account. It is not set when there is none.
- `max_retention_days` (Number) Maximum retention period, in days, that is allowed for the new objects in compliance or governance mode. It is not set when there is no maximum in days.
- `quota_object_bytes` (Number) Quota of the tenant, in bytes. It is not set when there is no quota.
- `use_account_identity_source` (Boolean) Whether the tenant uses its own identity source (`true`), or the identity source of the grid (`false`).
